author: GamingBolt
description:
Built to be a significant leap forward, much like the last numbered entry, Grand Theft Auto 4 focused more on bringing Liberty City to life. But with Niko, Rockstar wanted to create a more fully fleshed-out protagonist and avoid its usual approach of inspiration from crime movies and other fiction. It also placed far greater emphasis on realism in the visuals and animations, and with the gameplay, GTA 4 introduced a feature that would become a staple of the franchise: The cellphone.

It begins with Liberty City in the backdrop – the setting for what should be a new life.
title: GTA 4 Full Story Explained - Before You Play GTA 6

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time can get quite immersive thanks to Hyrule’s visual upgrades and a world that brings so many secrets, references, and hidden interactions to the table. Uncovering as many of them as you can is a very important part of the fun in this one, and a great way to engage with the game as it was designed to be enjoyed.

We’ve put together a few of them in one place to get you started, and perhaps even inspire you to indulge your curiosity and perhaps even an intrusive thought or two as you go around a world that’s built for them. From hilarity to awe, there’s a lot to like in this one and a few insightful looks behind the scenes as well.
title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake - 15 Incredible Details You Probably Missed

author: GamingBolt
description:
These critiques and differences aside, there’s no escaping that Watch Dogs 2 feels very much like GTA in atmosphere, NPC interactions, freedom, and potent spontaneous chaos. 

The sandbox may be distinct, but the loop is familiar. Much like we expect of GTA 6, you can enter Watch Dogs 2 with a simple plan and spend the next hour following distractions and dodging the consequences. 

If you’re looking for something to play before Grand Theft Auto 6, Watch Dogs 2’s experience is our non-Rockstar recommendation.
title: Watch Dogs 2 Is The Closest Thing To GTA 6 You Can Play Right Now
